QF.id: VII Introduction to Securities Broking Operations_95

question.text: SEBI mandated uniform exchange transaction charges by MIIs to achieve what objective?

answer.text: Increase transparency for end investors by eliminating volume-based slab discounts
Reduce the number of active traders

explanation.text: The Logic: In July 2024, SEBI mandated MIIs to use uniform transaction charges, eliminating volume-based slab discounts for brokers, in order to increase transparency for end investors. The Trap: The objective of the reform is investor-facing transparency, not exchange revenue, trader counts, or IT simplification. Note: Page 118 supports the July 2024 mandate, the elimination of volume-based slab discounts, and the transparency objective; the 'true-to-label' label, hidden-margin assertions and the Rs.3/Rs.5 per crore example are not stated on the page checked.
